title: Interview with Mina
summary: Dana interviewed Mina, an engineer, in a newsroom interview.

qa_highlights.question: What are you working on next?
qa_highlights.answer: A longer field study across three regions starting in the spring

qa_highlights.question: Tell me about a project that failed.
qa_highlights.answer: A mobile version nobody asked for cost six months and taught them to ask first

qa_highlights.question: How big was the team at the beginning?
qa_highlights.answer: Three people in a rented garage sharing a single laptop

qa_highlights.question: How do you keep a balance?
qa_highlights.answer: Protects Sundays with no messages or screens and a long walk

quotes.speaker: Mina
quotes.text: It cost us six months and taught us to ask first.

quotes.speaker: Mina
quotes.text: No messages, no screens, just a long walk.
